steps.title: Alerts that wait for your answer
steps.body: An urgent alert now rings for 5 minutes (set 1 to 15 in the phone app's settings), and you can snooze it for 5, 15, 30 minutes or an hour. Claude hears what you did: attended, dismissed, snoozed, or no answer, and carries on from there. While it waits it can keep working in the background.

steps.title: Allow secrets for one chat
steps.body: Let a chat use chosen secrets without asking for the PIN each time: for 15 minutes, an hour, 8 hours, or until the chat ends. Open the lock in the chat's header, or choose Allow for this chat when a PIN is asked for. It only lets the chat run commands with them; the values are never shown. PINs stay in the server's memory, never on disk, and you can see and revoke each one.

steps.title: Secret PINs with your fingerprint
steps.body: The phone app can keep secret PINs behind your fingerprint. When a secret is asked for, a fingerprint button sits where Unlock is: touch it and the PIN goes in by itself. Type instead and Unlock comes back. Turn it on in the app's settings; the bubble now shows secret requests too.
